notes.title: Wilderness Edge Demo – Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]We’ve rolled out a small but important update to the [i]Wilderness Edge[/i] demo![/p][p]This patch includes the addition of a [b]new smaller island[/b], created to better fit the solo nature of the demo experience. We’ve also made adjustments to the [b]deer spawn location[/b] near the player’s starting area for better balance and flow.[/p][p]Most importantly, the [b]character rendering issue has been fixed[/b]—players should now see their character fully appear upon loading in.[/p][p]Please remember: this demo is a work-in-progress and represents just a slice of the full game. Some minor bugs may remain. All future updates and major improvements will be included in the [b]full release[/b].[/p][p]Thank you for continuing to support Wilderness Edge![/p]

notes.title: MAJOR DEMO UPDATE – NEW ISLAND + SPAWN IMPROVEMENTS!
notes.content:
[p][b]What’s New:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]New, Smaller Island[/b] – A new island has been added, designed specifically for the [b]single-player demo[/b]. It’s more focused and optimized for performance while still offering a rich survival sandbox.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spawn Area Improvements[/b] – Adjusted deer placement and overall spawn layout for better pacing and immersion right from the start.[/p][/*][*][p][b]General Fixes & Tweaks[/b] – Minor updates under the hood to smooth out gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issue:[/b]
We’re aware of a bug where the [b]player character may not fully render[/b] upon loading. While visuals may appear incomplete, the character is still [b]fully playable[/b]. We're actively investigating and will push a fix soon.[/p][p]Thank you for testing, exploring, and surviving with us!
Your feedback helps shape the future of [i]Wilderness Edge[/i].[/p]
